pages.notes: Nc3-Nxe4 is a correct recapture route the parser cannot read yet: added to skips. British spelling only.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Bellon Gambit
pages.notes: Overview and plans treated it as a pawn-up gambit with a d5-e6-f5 structure Black cannot have after ...fxe4. Rewrote overview, plans 1, 3 and 4 around the standard Bg5xf6 and Nxe4 recapture (reviewer: 2 rejected, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch Defense: Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 named a c6-d5-e6-f5 chain and ...Ne4 with no knight on f6. Reworded plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 read control of e4 as a move. Reworded plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 3 put White's e4 push into Black's plan. Rewrote plan 3 (Classical or Stonewall set-up); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 led with ...h6 and ...g5; plan 3 played ...Qe8-h5 through the king and the g6-pawn. Rewrote both around the Leningrad ...Qe8 and ...e5; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 4 played Qe8-h5 with the king on e8. Rewrote plan 4 (...e6, ...Be7, ...O-O first); British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 e6 4.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 3 suggested g5 with the bishop on g5; plan 1 overstated Bxf6 damaging the structure. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 e6 4.e3 d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the bishop through e8 with the king there; plan 2 read e5 as a move and called f3 a break. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Dutch: 2.c4 Nf6 3.Nc3 g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Qe8-h5 through the g6-pawn and king. Rewrote plans 1 and 4 around the Leningrad set-up; British spelling.
